headlines.headline: FIFTH-YEAR ELIGIBILITY RULING TRIGGERS TRANSFER PORTAL CHAOS ACROSS COLLEGE HOOPS
headlines.detail: Class-wide injunction opened a special Aug. 3-10 transfer window; Arizona, North Carolina, Tennessee and Gonzaga add fifth-year players. NCAA Tournament expands from 68 to 76 teams next season.

headlines.headline: NBA RELEASES FULL 2026-27 SCHEDULE; RUSSELL WESTBROOK RETIRES
headlines.detail: LeBron/Jaylen Brown-boosted 76ers land a league-high 34 national TV games; season opens Oct. 30 with a Knicks-76ers/Lakers-Warriors NBA Cup doubleheader. Nine-time All-NBA guard Russell Westbrook retires at 37.

headlines.headline: PRESEASON WEEK 1 KICKS OFF WITH SIX GAMES AS ROSTER MOVES PILE UP
headlines.detail: Broncos place C Michael Deiter on IR (season-ending quad injury); Ravens LB Pernell McPhee retires; Cardinals QB Carson Beck out with a rib injury.

headlines.headline: FALL CAMPS IN FULL SWING NATIONWIDE AS TEAMS SORT OUT QUARTERBACK BATTLES
headlines.detail: Ohio State, Texas A&M and Boston College among programs deep into fall camp; QB competitions and portal-driven roster turnover dominate storylines.
